summary: API-mob test: EasyEntranceCheckInCest::testWithoutEasyEntrance — infinite recursion in Utils::sendException causes OOM

ai.s: Fixes an infinite recursion in exception reporting that crashed the mobile check-in endpoint with out-of-memory errors during API tests.
ai.pr: Utils::sendException, sendDiscordNotify and addToQueue called each other in a loop, hitting PHP's 256 nesting limit and exhausting memory so checkin/set returned invalid JSON.
ai.wy: A failing api-mob test exposed a crash path in error handling that could affect check-in.
ai.oc: The checkin/set endpoint is to return a valid 200 JSON response and persist the check-in, with the recursion in Utils.php broken.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: UpdateParentChildExhibitorCest — server crashes on exhibitor/set (cURL error 52)

ai.s: Fixes a public API server crash on exhibitor/set so parent and child exhibitor create/update requests return valid responses.
ai.pr: The public API server returned an empty reply (cURL error 52) on every exhibitor/set POST, failing 3 parent/child exhibitor tests.
ai.wy: Failing api-public tests showed an exhibitor write endpoint crashing for integration consumers.
ai.oc: exhibitor/set is to return valid JSON and create or update exhibitor records so the 3 tests pass.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: ExportCest — server crashes on meetings/export (cURL error 52)

ai.s: Fixes public API crashes on meetings/export so it returns correct JSON and status codes, including 403 for unauthorised users.
ai.pr: meetings/export crashed with empty replies on most requests and returned 500 instead of 403 for unauthorised users, failing 6 tests.
ai.wy: Failing api-public tests showed the meetings export endpoint was unreliable for API consumers.
ai.oc: meetings/export is to return valid JSON with correct status codes (403, 400, 200) so ExportCest passes.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: ExportValidationCest — server crashes on meetings/export validation (cURL error 52)

ai.s: Fixes meetings/export crashing during parameter validation so invalid input returns 400 errors instead of an empty server reply.
ai.pr: All 25 validation variants of ExportValidationCest failed because meetings/export crashed (cURL error 52) instead of validating parameters.
ai.wy: Failing api-public tests showed the export endpoint did not validate input safely.
ai.oc: meetings/export is to return 400 with error messages for invalid parameters and 200 for valid ones.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: GetAccountCest — server crashes on account/get (cURL error 52)

ai.s: Fixes public API crashes on account/get so visitor account retrieval returns valid JSON and correct status codes.
ai.pr: account/get crashed with an empty server reply on every request, failing all 6 GetAccountCest tests.
ai.wy: Failing api-public tests showed a core visitor read endpoint crashing.
ai.oc: account/get is to return valid JSON responses with correct HTTP status codes so the tests pass.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: SetAccountCest — server crashes on account/set (cURL error 52)

ai.s: Fixes public API crashes on account/set so visitor account writes return valid JSON and correct status codes, including 403 for unauthorised calls.
ai.pr: account/set crashed on most requests and returned 500 instead of 403 for unauthorised users, failing 7 SetAccountCest tests.
ai.wy: Failing api-public tests showed a core visitor write endpoint crashing.
ai.oc: account/set is to return 403, 400 or 200 as appropriate with valid JSON so the tests pass.

summary: [Test Fail] API-public test: SessionFiltersCest — /profileappnew returns 500 on getSynchronise

ai.s: Fixes a 500 error on /profileappnew mobile synchronisation so offline events with session filters sync correctly.
ai.pr: /profileappnew returned 500 Internal Server Error when called with getSynchronise=true and a valid event_id, failing 5 session-filter test variants.
ai.wy: Failing API tests showed mobile event synchronisation breaking for events with session filters.
ai.oc: /profileappnew is to return 200 with the offline event and its filters in created.event.

summary: [Test Fail] Notification additional filters return wrong results — 3 test failures

ai.s: Fixes notification additional filters (combined, no meeting requests sent, rejected meetings) that returned no matching accounts.
ai.pr: Three notification additional-filter tests failed because expected accounts were missing, mostly with empty results.
ai.wy: Failing functional tests showed notification targeting filters selecting the wrong audience.
ai.oc: Notification additional filters are to return the accounts matching their criteria so the 3 tests pass.

summary: Sessions search rejects valid orderBy targets — 3 test errors

ai.s: Fixes sessions search so ordering by title or end time is accepted rather than rejected as an invalid target.
ai.pr: Sessions search threw "Wrong orderBy target" for 'title', '-title' and '[end]', causing 3 test errors.
ai.wy: Part of improving Search & Elasticsearch; failing tests showed valid sort options being rejected.
ai.oc: Sessions search is to accept 'title' and '[end]' as orderBy targets so OrderBySessionsCest passes.

summary: [Test Fail] Campaign service test failures — 28 errors across 5 test classes

ai.s: Fixes 28 campaign service test errors caused by a missing statistics config, AccountEvents validation failures and round table render mismatches.
ai.pr: Five campaign test classes failed: DI::getConfigStatistics() returned null, AccountEvents failed validation, and round table details rendered mismatched data.
ai.wy: A broken campaign test suite undermines confidence in email campaign processing.
ai.oc: Statistics config, AccountEvents saving and round table rendering are to be corrected so the campaign tests pass.

summary: [Test Fail] Incomplete exhibitor profile filter returns empty results — 12 failures

ai.s: Fixes the incomplete exhibitor profile filter, which returned no exhibitors even when profiles were missing connections, images or categories.
ai.pr: All 12 IncompleteExhibitorProfileConditionsFilterCest tests failed because the filter returned an empty array.
ai.wy: Failing tests showed organisers could not target exhibitors with incomplete profiles.
ai.oc: The filter is to return exhibitors matching the incompleteness criteria so the 12 tests pass.

summary: [Test Fail] LowLevelsOfOptIns filter generates wrong SQL conditions — 4 failures

ai.s: Fixes the LowLevelsOfOptIns filter so it generates the expected SQL JOIN and threshold conditions.
ai.pr: Four tests failed because the filter no longer produced the expected subquery JOIN and response_count conditions for various thresholds.
ai.wy: Failing tests suggested the filter implementation had changed and was targeting the wrong accounts.
ai.oc: The filter is to generate correct SQL JOIN and WHERE conditions for all threshold values.

summary: [Test Fail] Low levels of opt-ins filter service failures — 4 failures

ai.s: Fixes the low-levels-of-opt-ins filter service, which wrongly included accounts above the connection threshold.
ai.pr: Four filter service tests failed: the SQL condition was not added correctly and accounts exceeding the connection threshold were included.
ai.wy: Failing tests showed the filter would target the wrong audience.
ai.oc: The filter service is to generate correct conditions and exclude accounts above the threshold.

summary: [Test Fail] Meeting program test failures — 21 errors across multiple classes

ai.s: Fixes 21 meeting program test failures, covering missing custom points, null time slots, role restrictions and wrong decline status.
ai.pr: Meeting program tests failed on an undefined customPoints index, getStart() on null, object-as-array use, missing role-restriction exceptions and 'canceled' instead of 'pending' on decline.
ai.wy: Failing tests exposed defects in meeting creation and scheduling logic.
ai.oc: The five error types are to be fixed so the meeting program test classes pass.

summary: [Test fail] [speednet] SpeedNetworking service test failures — 3 failures

ai.s: Fixes Speed Networking service defects in team member sort order and the exception type thrown when restoring attendance.
ai.pr: Team members came back in the wrong sort order, and restoring attendance from invalid statuses threw a Phalcon model exception instead of SpeedNetworkingException.
ai.wy: Part of improving the Speed Networking service; 3 failing tests exposed the defects.
ai.oc: Team members are to be returned in the correct order and invalid restore attempts to throw SpeedNetworkingException.

summary: [Test Fail] EmailDataBuilder getConfigStatistics() returns null — 9 test errors

ai.s: Fixes 9 EmailDataBuilder test errors by registering the statistics config in the functional test DI container.
ai.pr: DI::getConfigStatistics() returned null in the test environment because the statistics config was not registered during functional test bootstrap.
ai.wy: Classified as a test-environment issue that blocked campaign email tests.
ai.oc: Registering the statistics config in test bootstrap is expected to clear the 9 EmailDataBuilderCest errors.

summary: [Test fail] [speednet] SpeedNetworking model errors — isExhibitor missing, model not loaded

ai.s: Fixes Speed Networking model errors: a missing isExhibitor method and an unloadable account connections model, which caused 11 test errors.
ai.pr: SpeedNetworkingAccountRegistrations lacked isExhibitor and the speed_networking_account_connections model could not be loaded.
ai.wy: Part of improving the Speed Networking service; failing tests pointed to model defects.
ai.oc: The isExhibitor method is to exist and the connections model to load so the 11 tests pass.

summary: [TechDept] Backend PHPUnit: All 16 analytics tests fail with 401 Unauthorized

ai.s: Fixes authentication in the backend analytics PHPUnit tests so all 16 dashboard and registration analytics tests can run.
ai.pr: All 16 analytics tests failed with 401 because the test token in config.ini did not match any valid session in the local test database.
ai.wy: Tech debt: analytics tests gave no coverage while every request failed authentication.
ai.oc: Suggested fixes: seed a valid token or test user during bootstrap, or update tests to the current auth mechanism.

summary: Attendee opt‑in for AI‑populated sessions

ai.s: Lets attendees opt in or out of AI session recommendations per event, at registration or later from their profile.
ai.pr: AI Agenda Builder needs attendee consent before recommending sessions, and there was no preference to capture it.
ai.wy: Phase 1 of AI Agenda Builder moves from auto-population to recommendations with explicit consent.
ai.oc: Specified: a per-event 'Allow AI session recommendations' field on registration and profile; No stops new recommendations but keeps accepted sessions.

summary: Admin configuration of AI-populated sessions limit per Event

ai.s: Gives admins a per-event limit on how many AI-recommended sessions are proposed to each attendee, with 0 disabling recommendations.
ai.pr: Organisers had no way to control how much influence AI recommendations would have on attendee agendas.
ai.wy: Phase 1 of AI Agenda Builder: organiser control over AI suggestions.
ai.oc: Specified: an 'AI recommendation limit' in Program/Agenda configuration capping recommendation sets at N per event; changes apply to future sets only.
